# Utica Midstream

> A free daily read on oil and gas from wellhead to market: prices, stocks, pipelines, policy, projects and people, with every fact sourced and dated. Each edition has a price board (crude, gas, products and calculated spreads), market and stock notes, a lead story traced through upstream, midstream, downstream and the market, briefs by segment, a regulatory docket, basin watch, a weekly leader profile and an events calendar. General information, not investment advice.

## Today's edition
- [Oil falls to a three month low as the Iran war premium fades and stocks of crude build](https://uticamidstream.com/): November 24, 2026. $79.57. That was WTI early Tuesday, the lowest since late August, after crude lost 4.5% on Monday as Washington signaled more time for Iran diplomacy and inventory data pointed to a surplus.
- [Upstream: TotalEnergies buys more US gas from Continental Resources](https://uticamidstream.com/#money)
- [Upstream: Egypt presses Chevron and Eni to speed up the Nargis gas field](https://uticamidstream.com/#world)
- [Midstream: Permian gas flaring heads for a three year low as new pipes take the gas](https://uticamidstream.com/#permian)
- [Gas and LNG: Henry Hub swings 31 cents as December options expire today](https://uticamidstream.com/#gas)
